name: AI2 Reasoning Challenge (ARC)
summary: 7,787 multiple-choice science questions from standardized tests for grades 3 to 9, split into a Challenge Set and an Easy Set.

license.note: The Hugging Face card is tagged CC BY-SA 4.0, but the README in AI2's original download says "Do not distribute" and "Non-commercial use only", and some questions are used under license from a research partner.

cite: Clark, P., Cowhey, I., Etzioni, O., Khot, T., Sabharwal, A., Schoenick, C., & Tafjord, O. (2018). Think you have Solved Question Answering? Try ARC, the AI2 Reasoning Challenge. arXiv:1803.05457
